svg.aria-label: How a Bloom filter speeds up LSM-tree reads. To look up a key that may not exist, the engine would otherwise read every SSTable on disk. Each SSTable has a small in-memory Bloom filter; it answers either definitely not here, so the file is skipped, or maybe here, so the file is read. About 10 bits per key gives roughly a 1 percent false-positive rate.
